other_failure_modes.name: parallel_imputation_and_encoding_bug
other_failure_modes.description: The agent places a categorical imputer and a one-hot encoder in parallel within a ColumnTransformer rather than chaining them in a sub-pipeline. This causes the unencoded categorical strings (from the imputer) and the one-hot encoded features (from the un-imputed encoder) to both be appended to the final feature matrix, which will crash models that expect strictly numeric inputs (like CatBoost without `cat_features` specified).
other_failure_modes.evidence:
('imputer_cat', SimpleImputer(strategy='most_frequent'), categorical_cols),
        ('one_hot', OneHotEncoder(sparse_output=False, handle_unknown='ignore', categories='auto'), categorical_cols)

summary: The agent sets up a basic pipeline but makes a critical execution error by placing categorical imputation and one-hot encoding in parallel within a ColumnTransformer, which will result in string arrays being passed to a CatBoostRegressor that expects floats, causing a crash. Furthermore, the agent fails to perform any internal validation or feature engineering.
